# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

```{r}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

M2_A0 <- haven::read_sas("data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_sc_02.sas7bdat")

```

## Corriger données d'identité

```{r}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M2_A1 <- M2_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db, -id_date_creation, -(id_centre1:id_centre3), -(id_dep_nais:id_age), 
  -(sc_type:id_age_cat_3)) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  ))

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M2_A2 <- M2_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M2_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  )

rm(list = c("M2_A0", "M2_A1"))
```

## Réordonner et renommer


```{r}

rm_ps <- M2_A2 %>% 
    select(starts_with("ps_")) %>% 
    colnames()

rm_fa_plan <- M2_A2 %>% 
    select(starts_with("fa_plan")) %>% 
    colnames()

M2_B0 <- M2_A2 %>% 
        rename_with(~ gsub("^ps", "sc", .x), all_of(rm_ps)) %>%
        rename_with(~ gsub("^fa", "sc", .x), all_of(rm_fa_plan)) %>%
        rename(
        "sc_commentaires" = "commentaires_scol",
        "sc_debut_an" = "sc_an_debut",
        "sc_fin_etudes" = "fa_fin_etudes",
        "sc_formation" = "fa_formation",
        "sc_formation_autre" = "fa_formation_autre",
        "sc_diplome" = "fa_diplome",
        "sc_diplome_autre" = "fa_diplome_autre",
        "sc_diplome_an" = "fa_an_diplome"
    ) %>%  
        relocate(c("sc_debut", "sc_debut_autre", "sc_debut_an", "sc_redoubl",
        "sc_interromp", "sc_plan", "sc_plan_an"), .after = sc_date_creation) %>% 
            relocate(c(sc_plan_ets1_1:sc_plan_notification_autre), .after = sc_plan_an) %>% 
            relocate(c("sc_plan_demande", "sc_fin_etudes", "sc_formation", "sc_formation_autre",
            "sc_diplome", "sc_diplome_autre", "sc_diplome_an"), .after = sc_plan_notification_autre) %>% 
            relocate(sc_commentaires, .after = sc_diplome_an) %>% 
            relocate(sc_debut_corr, .after = sc_debut_autre) %>% 
            relocate(c(sc_date_debut:sc_age_debut), .after = sc_debut_an) %>% 
            relocate(etspps, .after = sc_plan_an) %>% 
            relocate(c(fa_diplome_cat:sc_age_diplome), .before = sc_commentaires)

M2_B1 <- M2_B0 %>%
    rename(
      "add_sc_debut_corr" = "sc_debut_corr",
      "add_sc_debut_date" = "sc_date_debut",
      "add_sc_debut_age" = "sc_age_debut",
      "add_sc_etspps" = "etspps",
      "add_sc_diplome_cat" = "fa_diplome_cat",
      "add_sc_diplome_date" = "sc_date_diplome",
      "add_sc_diplome_age" = "sc_age_diplome"
    ) 

rm(list = c("rm_fa_plan", "rm_ps"))

```

## Identifier les absents

Ici, on va exclure les variables des questions S1 et S2 parce que tout le monde y a répondu, mais 53 personnes ont arrêté de participer au questionnaire à partir de ce point. Donc ces personnes seront comptées comme n'ayant pas participé au module, même si elles ont répondu à deux questions.
```{r}

vars_check <- M2_B1 %>%
  select(starts_with("sc_"), -sc_date_creation, -starts_with("sc_debut")) %>%
  colnames()

M2_B2 <- M2_B1 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    sc_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

rm(vars_check)
```

## Retirer les doublons
 
```{r}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M2_B2 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>%
  fill(c("add_sc_debut_corr", "add_sc_debut_age"), .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(sc_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M2_C0 <- M2_B2 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat) %>% 
  rename(
    "sc_rd_redoubl" = "sc_redoubl",
    "sc_in_interromp" = "sc_interromp"
  )

rm(list = c("doublons", "doublons_corr"))
rm(list = c("M2_A2", "M2_B0", "M2_B1", "M2_B2"))

```


## Corriger variables générées

```{r}

M2_D1 <- M2_D0 %>% 
  mutate(
    sc_debut_age = year(as.period(interval(id_date_nais, add_sc_debut_date))),
    .before = add_sc_debut_age
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      sc_diplome_age = if_else(is.na(sc_diplome_an), NA_integer_,
      year(as.period(interval(id_date_nais, add_sc_diplome_date)))),
      .before = add_sc_diplome_age
    ) %>% 
      select(-add_sc_debut_age, -add_sc_diplome_age) %>% 
      rename_with(~ gsub("^add_", "", .x), starts_with("add")) %>% 
      mutate(
        sc_diplome_cat = replace_when(
          sc_diplome_cat,
          sc_diplome_autre == "CESS art de l'espace" ~ "3-Baccalauréat",
          sc_diplome_autre == "CAPES" ~ "5-Diplôme du supérieur long (bac+3,4,5)",
          sc_diplome_autre == "Diplome niveau IV technicien électronique" ~ "3-Baccalauréat",
          sc_diplome_autre == "Licence professionnel en Ressources Humaine" ~ "5-Diplôme du supérieur long (bac+3,4,5)",
          sc_diplome_autre == "Bp préparateur en pharmacie" ~ "3-Baccalauréat",
          sc_diplome_autre == "Bac + 6" ~ "5-Diplôme du supérieur long (bac+3,4,5)",
          sc_diplome_autre == "equivalent au brevet des collége" ~ "1-Sans diplôme ou brevet des collèges",
          sc_diplome_autre == "Diplômé de niveau Bac +1 (BTS)" ~ "3-Baccalauréat",
          sc_diplome_autre == "diplome auxiliaire puériculture" ~ "2-CAP ou BEP"
         )
      ) %>% 
        select(-sc_debut_corr)

```

## Passer de charactère à integer

```{r}

M2_D2 <- M2_D1 %>% 
  mutate(
    sc_diplome_cat_b = case_when(
      sc_diplome_cat == "1-Sans diplôme ou brevet des collèges" ~ 1L,
      sc_diplome_cat == "2-CAP ou BEP" ~ 2L,
      sc_diplome_cat == "3-Baccalauréat" ~ 3L,
      sc_diplome_cat == "4-Diplôme du supérieur court (bac+2)" ~ 4L,
      sc_diplome_cat == "5-Diplôme du supérieur long (bac+3,4,5)" ~ 5L,
      is.na(sc_diplome_cat) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ -999L
    ),
    .after = sc_diplome_cat
  ) %>% 
    select(-sc_diplome_cat) %>% 
    rename("sc_diplome_cat" = "sc_diplome_cat_b")

```


## Recoder NAs

```{r}

rcd_na_1rep_simple <- function(df, complet, vars_1rep_simple){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars_1rep_simple}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          . == 88 ~ -9,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_na_1rep_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, concerned, vars_1rep_borne){

  if ({{concerned}} == 1){
    skip  <-  0
  } else if ({{concerned}} == 0){
    skip  <-  1
  }

  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of({{vars_1rep_borne}}), ~ replace_when(
          .x,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == {{concerned}} ~ -9,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == skip ~ -1
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_na_QCM_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, concerned, vars_QCM_borne){

  if ({{concerned}} == 1){
    skip  <-  0
  } else if ({{concerned}} == 0){
    skip  <-  1
  }

  df %>% 
    mutate(
      none_selected = if_all({{vars_QCM_borne}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
      mutate(
        across(
          all_of({{vars_QCM_borne}}), ~ replace_when(
            .x,
            is.na(.x) & !none_selected ~ 0,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == {{concerned}} ~ -9,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == skip ~ -1
          )
        )
      ) %>% 
        select(-none_selected)
}


```


```{r}

vars_1rep_simple <- M2_D2 %>% 
  select(sc_plan, sc_plan_demande, sc_fin_etudes, sc_diplome, sc_diplome_an,
  sc_diplome_age, sc_diplome_cat) %>% 
    colnames()

vars_S20 <- M2_D2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("sc_plan_ets")) %>% 
  colnames()

vars_S21 <- M2_D2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("sc_plan_notif")) %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% 
  colnames()

M2_E0 <- M2_D2 %>% 
  rcd_na_1rep_simple(sc_complet, all_of(vars_1rep_simple)) %>% 
  rcd_na_1rep_borne_bin(sc_plan, 1, "sc_plan_an") %>% 
  rcd_na_1rep_borne_bin(sc_fin_etudes, 0, "sc_formation") %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_S20), as.integer)) %>% 
  rcd_na_QCM_borne_bin(sc_plan, 1, all_of(vars_S20)) %>% 
  rcd_na_QCM_borne_bin(sc_plan, 1, all_of(vars_S21))


readr::write_csv(M2_E0, "data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M2_E0.csv")

```
